system.description:
Across the galaxy, and likely the universe, the most common form of life is microscopic. From the earliest life forms in an evolutionary chain to the gut flora of an uncountable quantity of apex predators, single celled and simple multicellular organisms flourish in places other life cannot.

Bacto sapiens are such creatures who, whether through strange evolution or anomalous events, join together in massive colonies of biomass and form a body-plan using themselves as component cells as if in a larger animal. Individually alive, each provides or takes part in a psionic construct of a self. Such bacto sapiens often take on a humanoid form to better interact with societies that develop around such a form, but exist as natural shapeshifters due to their composite structure. In this form, they often appear as vaguely translucent hominids of a blue, green, or grey tone.

Bacto sapiens often appear slightly moist or damp in their natural state, as their component pieces require some degree of fluid to exist in a comfortable state. However, when they take on the form of another species, their outer layer often dries up quite noticeably, easily taking on the softness of skin or the hardness of carapace with all appropriate roughness or smoothness. It is unclear if this damages the bacto sapiens’ component creatures or not, as they often cycle through the composite form in an endless churn that can be magical to witness in their native form.

While created as a composite of countless organisms, bacto sapiens rarely use the term “we” to refer to themselves. Often, instead, they name themselves as a community and speak from the first person perspective as that community rather than as a representative of that community. Indeed, the first recorded instance of communication with a bacto sapiens involved one known simply as “Colony” who had been a humanoid who psychically imprinted himself on a massive bacterial biomass.

Bacto Sapiens Traits

Type: Humanoid (Ooze). While their psychic impression is one of a humanoid type, allowing them to be affected by spells and effects which target humanoids, they gain the ooze subtype as well.

Age: It is difficult to determine the age of either a bacto sapiens or their component creatures due both to the continual churn of their structure and the various stages of life of each component creature which may or may not have undergone mitosis. However, they can live up to eighty years with no loss of function. Their maximum age has not been determined.

Size: Medium. A bacto sapiens enduring extreme conditions often reduces their living biomass through death and shedding in order to protect themselves, making them one of the few species capable of changing size based on external effects. See “Shedding” below.

Speed: Your base speed is 30ft if you are medium and 25ft if you are small.

Shapeshifting: As an action, a bacto sapiens can change their shape, texture, and color. This allows you to appear as another creature or object of medium or small size that you have interacted with, though this changes none of your character’s traits such as AC or HP. In some cases this may allow you to perform the role of an object, such as a bucket, but it provides you no protection against damage caused by that use. This allows you control over your physical appearance, including hair, clothing, and coloration within the norms of the chosen Heritage. However, you gain no bonus to convincing others that you are a member of the heritage you appear as, or the object you take the form of, due to the natural sheen and slight discoloration of your component pieces.

You can use this ability for a total of 4 hours each day spent in 1 hour increments. You recover all use at the end of a long rest.

Shedding: A bacto sapiens of Medium size who fails their second death saving throw may choose to instead become a small sized Bactosapiens with 1hp, stabilizing and waking as their dead biomass sloughs away. Recovering your full size requires a long rest in a Haven.

Environmental Difficulties: Bacto Sapiens are most comfortable and capable between 5c and 60c (41f and 135f). When outside of these ranges for extended periods, they gain 1 level of fatigue per hour that can be recovered during a short rest in a temperate environment.

Bacto Sapiens Gifts

Bacto Sapiens can arise from a variety of different bacterial strains across the galaxy, some of which possess unique traits. In rare cases, Bacto Sapiens are a combination of multiple types of microscopic species. Choose one of the following bacto sapiens gifts:

Vulcanofauna

Vulcanofauna bacto sapiens form from bacteria in and around thermal vents or other extremely hot environments. As such, they are extremely well suited to hot environments and possess natural defenses against heat. Such composite bacteria require a different diet than your standard carbon-based life form and sustain themselves chemolithotrophically by consuming sulfur and nitrogen as core dietary elements, often supplemented with high iron content.

Heat Resistance: You no longer face environmental difficulties at temperatures above 60c (135f). In addition, you gain resistance to Fire damage.

Acidic Strike: You may choose to deal Acid damage with your unarmed strikes due to your composite body’s dietary requirements. Gripping an object while using this ability allows you to deal 1 + Constitution modifier acid damage to the object each round.

Psychrophile

Psychrophiles, or cryophilic bacteria, thrive in cold environments and even under thick layers of ice. They are, thusly, well adapted to harsh cold climates with little access to sunlight, resources, or even liquid water. Adapting to such a harsh environment requires extreme cellular control both for the purposes of photosynthesis and avoiding ice-expansion destroying cellular membranes.

Vitrify: You may spend a bonus action to alter your cellular membranes into a hard crystalline structure that is particularly durable. Doing so reduces your movement speed by 5ft but grants you a +1 AC bonus and allows you to live normally in environments below 5c (41f) without difficulty. Vitrification forcibly reverts you to your natural form, and you cannot shapeshift while vitrified. You can end this state by spending another bonus action to revert your cellular membranes.

Photosynthetic: More than most bacto sapiens, you rely on sunlight to sustain yourself. So long as you are exposed to natural sunlight or UV rays each day, you can go a number of days equal to your Constitution score without supply and gain no fatigue.

Anaerobic

Anaerobic bacto sapiens do not require air to survive and reproduce. While they don’t enjoy the extreme temperature protections enjoyed by their erstwhile cousins, they tend to be more exposed to the natural range of temperatures and the dangers imposed by the creatures who live there such as antibiotics.

Anaerobic: You do not need to breathe. You cannot drown or suffocate and do not take damage or other effects from inhaled toxins.

Antibiotic Resistance: You gain resistance to poison damage.

Bactosapien Paragon Traits

Once you reach 10th level, you gain a trait from the following list.

Changeling

Your shapeshifting abilities are far more refined than the average bactosapien. You now gain expertise in Deception and Stealth to pretend to be an object or other humanoid, as the sheen and discolorations are now under thorough control. In addition, you may gain the benefits of the Alter Self spell whenever you use your shapeshifting ability. Finally, you may now shapeshift for a total of 8 hours per long rest.

Split

Your ability to control your component selves increases dramatically, allowing you to split your consciousness across two selves each with half your current HP. You must be at Medium size to use this ability, but divide yourself into two Small selves. Each Small version of you gets to move on your initiative up to 25ft. But your action, any bonus action, and reaction are split between the two selves.

While split in this way, you may partake in two journey or downtime activities at the same time. One can take a long rest while the other keeps watch and so forth. If one of your selves is killed, the other can regrow during a long rest in a safe haven as described in the shedding heritage trait.

You can use this ability for a total of 8 hours spent in 1 hour increments and recover all use of the ability at the end of a long rest.
